reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so the sachet-to-go part solves nothing for me. I'm not paying $25-30 a month for packaging when a bottle costs far less.
objection: I don't need it to go. I take it at home before bed, and a regular bottle does the same job for a lot less per day.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor confirming my levels are low and recommending this exact form, or a price close to what a plain bottle of magnesium bisglycinate costs.
